about_the_game:
A co-op survival horror game. Play as 1 of 4 ordinary shoppers who wake up in an endless store. Find the exit together at all costs before the "employees" catch you.

Escape Alone or With Friends 

Trapped inside a nightmarish store, you play as ordinary shoppers desperately looking for an exit.

Each run is different. Try your best to navigate changing layouts, departments, threats & items availability, and locations.

You can succeed alone, co-op is never forced, but working together can greatly increase your chances. The goal stays the same: GET OUT!

Coordinate your escape by using proxy voice chat and walkie-talkies. Remember to use your hard-earned perks and tools: Medkits, Traps, and Detectors will make your lives easier.

Day & Night

Opening hours: The store is lit, you must cover ground, map your surroundings, and find vital items. Every second counts as the clock is ticking.

Closed hours: When the lights go out "employees" roam free, lurking in the shadows looking for you.

  • Tactics are up to you & your team: hide in holes or ventilation, progress without making noise, use flashlights to fight the darkness but be careful as the batteries are limited.

  • Every error might lead the relentless "employees" straight to you. Find fuses to turn the lights back on and hopefully start a new day.

Key Features

  • Up to 4 Player Online Co-op: Be terrified playing alone or with friends

  • Proximity Voice Chat: Hear your friend's scream echoing in a different aisle

  • Walkie-Talkie: Use long-distance communication, beware of who might be listening

  • Immersive 3D Audio: Enjoy the unnerving noises breaking the silence of this not-so-empty store

  • Replayability: Take on greater challenges by completing the various tiers of difficulty

  • Gain Experience: Unlock and improve perks & tools to fit your playstyle and improve your chances

  • Adapt: Change your playstyle to accommodate the unique traits of the new survivor you embody each run, and maybe save their life

  • SCP-Inspired: experience horror with a twist of SCP-3008

Think you’ll make it out alive?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11a
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3330 3.0 GHz, AMD FX-8300 3.3 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 or Radeon HD 7970
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 or Radeon HD 7970
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4690 3.5 GHz, AMD Ryzen 3 1300X 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070TI or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
